summary: Diff adds a frontend backend-unavailable banner and some watch-page/backend error messaging, updates routing to use hash history with basic hash normalization, and enhances the ViewerTimer component UI/behavior. However, the diff does not include deployment documentation updates and does not provide sufficient evidence that mainnet access-path hardening (icp0 URL / gateway “Canister ID Not Resolved”) and Watch-page Viewer Timer visibility acceptance criteria are fully met.

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix the Watch page so the Viewer Timer UI is clearly visible and usable for all users on common screen sizes (mobile + desktop), including when the Watch page is reached via deep links.
missing_requirements.reason: While ViewerTimer was modified, the diff summary for WatchPage is truncated and does not clearly show that the Viewer Timer card is placed/laid out such that it is visible without scrolling on desktop and discoverable on mobile (e.g., explicit responsive placement/controls).

missing_requirements.requirement: Fix and harden the deployed-site access path so users do not encounter the gateway error “Canister ID Not Resolved” when opening the correct icp0.io URL for the deployed OmniStream frontend assets canister.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows hash-based routing and a small hash normalization, but no deployment/config/canister URL resolution changes or documentation that would concretely address the icp0 gateway resolution error. No changes to dfx/deploy settings are evidenced.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update the repo-local mainnet deployment documentation to explain which deployed canister URL must be used, how to obtain it after deployment, examples (root + hash deep link), and troubleshooting for “Canister ID Not Resolved”.
missing_requirements.reason: No documentation files (e.g., README, DEPLOYMENT guide) are shown as added/modified in the diff summary.
